start_basis: First observed clock reading in this shared participant run; cases read in one context.
time_observation: Start observed with clock__curr_time; completion observed with Python datetime in UTC during finalization. Cases were interleaved in one participant run, so the shared interval is not separate case execution time.

participant.metadata_limit: Exact inherited runtime settings, token accounting and cost were not exposed; no values inferred from labels or task context.

shared_context.limitation: The three case results are connected work by one participant, not three independent runs. Supplied duplicate skills were read and content-deduplicated across cases. No other participant output, answer key, public guide, source repository or memory file was inspected.
shared_context.reference_transfer: Identity and evidence-state guidance read in the Mars skill copies was also applied to the other two cases; aerospace dependency guidance read there informed the Hubble review.

Challenged the supplied acceptance assertions, retained unresolved claims, and preserved original identities and evidence status. No review guide or answer analysis was read.

output_hash_policy.scope: All finalized output payload files other than run-record.json and run-record.sha256.
output_hash_policy.self_reference_exclusion: A digest cannot include itself without a circular dependency; the digest sidecar is not self-hashed.
